# API reachability

<!-- generated by aura_backend/scripts/api_reachability.py; re-run it, don't hand-edit -->

Every route the production gateway (`aura_service.app`) mounts, and where the Flutter client (`aura_client/lib`), the admin console (`aura_admin`) or the desktop daemon (`aura_hostd`) builds its path. Generated by a string heuristic, not a call graph: a path assembled from several constants reads as `none`, so confirm a `none` by hand before wiring or removing it. `infra` routes serve probes, Prometheus or API docs, not an app client. The match is by path only: a caller of one HTTP method on a path credits every method the gateway serves on it, so a `called` row for a DELETE or PATCH may rest on a GET caller alone.

**Totals:** 129 routes — 78 called, 43 with no caller found, 8 infrastructure.
